r.name: Tappa 5 - Da Comeana a Firenze
r.description: The fifth leg goes towards the centre of Signa where you can visit the Straw Museum. Crossing the Parco dei Renai the path follows the Arno river to reach Parco delle Cascine, the gateway to Florence.

r.name: Tappa 6 - Attraverso Firenze
r.description: Sixth leg from Ponte all'Indiano, passing through Parco delle Cascine and the historic center of Firenze where there is the National Archaeological Museum.
